shortTitle: ERS Handbook of Respiratory Sleep Medicine
fullTitle: ERS Handbook of Respiratory Sleep Medicine
libraryStatus: A staged RPSGT V3 source map records a Guild Drive copy with 64 mapped chapters/subchapters and all 12 official RPSGT tasks represented. Private Drive access remains internal and is not exposed to learners.
apaCitation: Bonsignore, M. R., Randerath, W., Schiza, S. E., & Simonds, A. K. (Eds.). (2023). ERS handbook of respiratory sleep medicine (2nd ed.). European Respiratory Society.
bestFor: Contemporary respiratory-sleep physiology and clinical context, sleep-disordered-breathing definitions and limitations, oximetry and respiratory polygraphy limitations, capnography/CO2 concepts, central sleep apnea, hypoventilation, PAP/NIV, oxygen, obesity hypoventilation, and pediatric respiratory-sleep topics.
authorityBoundary: Current specialty study support, not the governing RPSGT rule source. Current AASM Scoring Manual Version 3 controls scoring and technical rules; ICSD-3-TR controls diagnostic classification; current AASM/AAST guidance, physician orders, facility policy, and manufacturer instructions control testing, PAP, oxygen, CO2 monitoring, central sleep apnea treatment, and other rule-sensitive care decisions when they differ from this handbook.
copyrightUse: Use bibliographic metadata, chapter/subchapter titles, page locators, and original Sleep Pathways Guild study directions only. Do not reproduce proprietary figures, tables, algorithms, or substantial protected prose.
